en.headline: Lee says independent building-maintenance agency worth considering
en.dek: At the second district forum on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address, the Chief Executive responded to public suggestions on housing, youth development and building repairs.
body: Chief Executive John Lee on Sunday led principal officials to a district forum at Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, the second such session collecting views on Hong Kong’s inaugural five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address.

About 120 members of the public from different backgrounds took part. Topics raised included accelerating Northern Metropolis development, youth housing, talent policies, innovation and technology, and people’s livelihood issues.

One participant proposed establishing an independent professional agency to handle building maintenance works so that owners would only need to contribute funds while receiving professional and reliable services. Lee said the suggestion was insightful and worth further consideration, provided it could ensure no corruption.

Lee noted that the Government has held more than 90 consultation sessions on the five-year plan and Policy Address. He said the team would consolidate the views received and aim to publish the five-year plan within the third quarter. The consultation period ends this Friday.

zh.headline: 李家超：獨立專業機構代辦樓宇維修值得考慮
zh.dek: 特首李家超周日率領司局長出席第二場五年規劃及2026年施政報告地區諮詢會，回應市民就房屋、青年發展及樓宇維修等建議。
body: 行政長官李家超周日率領多名司局長，在九龍塘官立小學舉行第二場香港首個五年規劃及2026年《施政報告》地區諮詢會，約120名不同背景市民出席。
市民提出的意見涵蓋加快北部都會區發展、青年置業、人才政策、創科及民生等多個範疇。
有出席者建議設立獨立專業機構代辦樓宇維修工程，市民只需分擔費用即可獲得專業可靠服務。李家超表示有關建議具見地，值得多加考慮，前提是確保不會出現腐敗問題。
李家超指政府已就五年規劃及施政報告舉行逾90場諮詢會，團隊會綜合意見，目標於第三季內發表五年規劃文件。諮詢期本周五結束。
